title: Why John Marston really joined Dutch's gang in Red Dead
subject: marston
description:
Would you have trusted Dutch at twelve? 👇

How an orphan named John Marston became an outlaw, and where his famous scars came from. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: John Marston was twelve when Dutch saved him from a noose.
His mother died giving birth in 1873, and his Scottish father was dead by 1881.
John ran from an orphanage, got caught stealing, and a crowd wanted him hanged.
Dutch van der Linde cut him loose and raised him beside Arthur Morgan.
The scars on his face came in 1899, when wolves caught him alone near Colter.
Arthur drove them off, and Javier Escuella carried him back to camp on his horse.
Twelve years later, the government made John hunt down that same family.
